one_line_summary: Most core genomic/typing and SGI-1 findings replicate; MDR source effect weakens and key mutation-based claims change under updated AMRFinderPlus.
notes: The reanalysis is genuinely independent (fresh AMR/MLST/SGI-1 calls) on real public assemblies and reproduces major descriptive and Typhimurium/SGI-1 conclusions. Two important mutation-centric claims (ramR association and “100%” QRDR/sox/pmr mutations) do not replicate and are plausibly explained by database/version differences and prior synonymous-variant counting. The LN vs GB MDR association matches direction but loses significance and magnitude due to missing isolates and a different (genotypic vs phenotypic) MDR definition, which is transparently reported.
